Hi Lina and team,

Thanks — I've reviewed the invoice and the service category (SaaS/managed inference) is generally subject to reverse-charge for intra-EU B2B when the buyer is VAT-registered. To proceed we need:

1) VIES validation screenshot showing VAT SE556677889901 as active (attached accepted).
2) Confirmation of billing company name and registered address (matches our records).
3) Confirmation that Nordic Analytics will self-account for VAT under reverse-charge.

If those boxes are checked, we'll:
- Reissue invoice 1234 as 1234-RC with zero VAT and the required reverse-charge wording (article reference and buyer VAT ID).
- Include payment instructions unchanged and new invoice number.
- Set revised due date to the original terms (30 days) unless you need earlier.

I attached a sample reverse-charge clause we use for EU customers and a quick VIES validation checklist.
